title: Table

ports.note: Every port a table can show, on every table, whatever its parameters say. The ports used to vary with an inputMode parameter -- reasoningInput, polygonInput and a table mode were three separate declarations of that -- so the port a connection needed might not exist on the node. Which renderer shows is now read from what is wired: src/core.ts#shownMode. The same change map_output took at 0.15.0.

ontology.note: TableView activity is implemented; broader table artifact contracts remain open. `emits` records what the module named in implementation.definition asserts, and this widget is defined in src/core.ts#TYPES, which asserts nothing — the fw:TableView facts are built in the execution case and are gated by validate:ontology-coupling, which holds at zero undeclared. Same shape as map_output 0.15.0.

changes.description: On the standard Inspector and dialog (experiment 186): the name, which is the Results tab's, and where it goes in the write-up; its inputs, every port a table can show; one sentence and Configure…, which holds Show totals and, for a reasoning result, Display as; and what the last run showed.

A number is a value, never the headings. A column a table marks as numeric, such as the rise Relate brings beside each facility, was promoted to the axis when it held one value, and headed the distances "1124". It is now drawn as a column with its own heading.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. The self-description added in 0.6.0 is covered by tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (13 unit checks, including that nothing machined numbers its own artifact or calls itself a caption, that an unnamed artifact is left unnamed rather than titled, and that a unit is stated once) and by tests/equation-notes.browser.mjs over the South London example on Chromium and WebKit. Both were mutation-checked by reintroducing the behaviour they forbid. 0.8.0: tests/table-output-standard.browser.mjs checks the panel and the totals claim applied in Configure…; tests/crosstab.test.mjs checks that a numeric key with one value leaves the table as rows.
